# #160 — Memory tiering: promote agent lane (short-term) → own durable (mid/long-term)

## Goal

Continuous memory-tiering: promote an agent's **standard lane (short-term)** memories into that agent's **own durable (mid/long-term) namespace** when they graduate. This is the within-namespace half of the Hermes memory pipeline — no shared-write trust bar, since the agent already owns the destination.

## Context

This is steady-state successor work to #145. #145's legacy `collab → shared-kb` drain is a one-time input; this issue is the ongoing lane→durable tiering that runs as agents accumulate lane memory. Pairs with the higher-trust lane→shared-kb issue (sibling) and reuses the dreamer/promoter phase split.

## Model

- **Classifier/dreamer:** scans an agent's lane events, clusters/dedupes/scores, proposes which lane memories graduate to durable mid/long-term and which stay short-term or are archived as noise.
- **Promoter/executor:** applies graduations within the agent's own namespace with provenance + receipts. Dry-run and apply modes.

## Scope

- Resumable scan of lane(s) per agent namespace.
- Classify each lane item: graduate-to-durable | keep-short-term | duplicate/noise/archive | manual-review.
- Write graduated records to the agent's durable namespace with provenance (source lane/event ids, agent, timestamp, classification/confidence, promotion reason).
- Dry-run mode, apply mode, per-batch receipts.
- Idempotency / deterministic dup checks.
- Kill switch + low-load/backoff scheduling.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Dry-run reports graduation candidates without writes.
- Apply promotes a controlled batch into the agent's durable namespace with provenance.
- Re-running a batch is idempotent.
- Short-term/noise items are kept or archived, not blindly graduated.
- Admin can pause/stop.
- Metrics show graduated/kept/archived/manual-review counts and remaining backlog.

## Non-Goals
- No lane→shared-kb promotion (that is the sibling issue; different trust bar).
- No automatic unreviewed LLM truth promotion.
- No dropping provenance.

## Traps
- Dream proposes; promoter applies allowed moves only.
- Do not let channel noise graduate to durable memory.
- Do not promote from lanes whose writes are not proven to land (depends on Hermes write reliability — rtech-hermes#84).

## Dependencies
- Upstream: rtech-hermes#84 (lane writes must reliably land before graduation decisions are trustworthy).
- Sibling: lane→shared-kb promotion issue.
- Successor to: #145 (legacy drain).
